_comment: AVM System configuration (spec AVM-SPEC-2026-001 Rev0.1). Values marked PLACEHOLDER must be replaced with the real vessel/camera data (spec ch.7 items 1-6).

camera._comment: source: '' = simulated camera; '/dev/videoN' = V4L2; otherwise a full GStreamer pipeline ending in appsink (e.g. nvarguscamerasrc ...).

calibration._comment: eo_intrinsics: Kannala-Brandt fisheye. Defaults = ideal equidistant lens, 3040 px image circle = 180 deg (spec 3.2). Replace by the result of calib_fisheye: set "file": "eo_calib.json".

eo_mount._comment: PLACEHOLDER: camera height above the water, tilt below the horizon (spec ch.7 #6 installation data).

sync._comment: FR-1.3: IR frames further than tolerance_ms from the EO frame are excluded; FR-1.4: no frame for stale_timeout_ms => channel shown inactive.

agc._comment: FR-3.2 histogram based AGC for the IR windows.

pip._comment: FR-3.1 / FR-3.3: one window per IR camera; anchor = top_left|top_right|middle_left|middle_right|bottom_left|bottom_right|custom.

view._comment: FR-4: presets 0 forward perspective, 1 top-view (radius 15 m), 2 ROI zoom, 3 raw fisheye; FR-5: stabilization (costs FPS). fit_to_visible: no black areas - the top-view centre moves forward of the camera (a single forward fisheye cannot see behind itself) and perspective views narrow their FOV if needed; raw_fill: raw view is cropped to the image circle (false = whole sensor image).

inference._comment: FR-7. Phase-1 classes (6): see docs/ai_dataset_plan.md. backend: stub | opencv_dnn (ONNX on CPU, dev PC) | tensorrt (Jetson, pending).

blending._comment: FR-3.4 is optional (needs EO/IR baseline <= 10 cm). Not used by the default pipeline.

recording._comment: FR-9.1 manual start/stop with the 'r' key.
